## In our context

::: {.tip}
- Leakage in calculation data: runs of the **same design variant** in both train and test — use group K-Fold by variant
- A random split only tests interpolation; lifetime extension asks questions **outside** the original data
- Report where the training data ends: this becomes the domain of applicability in the model passport
:::

## Practice (40 min)

::: {.exercise}
1. Show overfitting and underfitting by varying model complexity
2. Reproduce a data-leakage example (same design variant in train and test) and fix it with group K-Fold
3. Evaluate a model with K-Fold
4. Compare Ridge, Lasso and ElasticNet
:::
